title: Expand the Subject
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can use subject pronouns (he/she/it/we/they) with the correct auxiliary verbs (does/is/do/are) and answer Yes-No questions naturally.

examples.text: I play basketball with my teammates.
I have a meeting with my colleague.

items.def: the person who leads your team

examples.text: I asked my manager for advice.
My client is very happy with our work.
I have a meeting with a new client.
I need to finish the report today.

items.def: the time when something must be finished

examples.text: I'm working hard to meet the deadline.
This app is very helpful for learning.

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

head: Subject
Engine
Question
Answer
rows: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
Yes, we do. / No, we don't.
Yes, they do. / No, they don't.
Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

items: DOES steals the -s: Does she WORK…? (not Does she works…?)
IS for BE information: Is he busy? (not Does he busy?)

reading.text: I work with a small sales team. Anna is our new teammate. She's friendly, and she's very good with clients. Minh is our manager. He's usually busy, but he's always helpful. We're working on a new project this week, so we're in the office every day. Our clients are in Singapore. They're easy to work with, but they need regular updates. I like my team because we support each other.
Notice: she's + adjective, he's + noun, we're + V-ing, they're + adjective. These are natural ways to describe people.

conversations.title: New coworker

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is your new coworker friendly?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. She's very easy to talk to.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she work in sales?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, she doesn't. She works in marketing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she work with you every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she does. We're on the same team.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she busy this week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. We have a new project.

check: Are they on the same team?
conversations.note: Notice: friendly → department → same team → busy this week.

conversations.title: Family photo
conversations.target: Is she…? · Does she…? · Are they…?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is she your sister?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she is. Her name is Mai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she live near you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, she doesn't. She lives in Hanoi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does she work there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, she does. She works for a bank.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are they your parents?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, they are. They live in Quy Nhon.

conversations.note: Notice: relationship → place → work → another person in the photo.

conversations.title: Busy team

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are they busy this week?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, they are. They have a new client.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do they have many meetings?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, they do. They have one every morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are they ready for the deadline?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not yet. They need one more day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do they need your help?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, they do. I'm checking the final report.

check: Are they ready for the deadline?
conversations.answers: 1. Yes, new client. 2. Yes, every morning. 3. Not yet.
conversations.note: Notice: busy → meetings → deadline → offer help.

listening.text: Shadowing · Nghe từng câu rồi nhắc lại
Bấm 🔊 để nghe từng câu, sau đó nhắc lại y hệt ngữ điệu. Làm 2 lượt: lượt 1 nhìn chữ, lượt 2 che chữ.

exercises.text: Đáp án: 1 Does · 2 Is · 3 Do · 4 Are · 5 Is. Quy tắc: he/she/it → does/is, we/they → do/are.
Đáp án: 1 Yes, she does. 2 Yes, he is. 3 Yes, they do. 4 Yes, we are. Quy tắc: trả lời đúng engine với câu hỏi.

speaking.text: Work with a partner. Ask 5 Yes-No questions about people you know. Use does/is/do/are correctly.
Use: Does he/she…? Is he/she…? Do they…? Are they…? Answer with Yes, … does/is/do/are.

roleplay.title: Mission 1 · New coworker
roleplay.context: Partner vừa nói công ty có nhân viên mới. Hỏi để biết người đó.
steps: Opener: Is your new coworker friendly?
Hỏi 4+ Yes–No: Does he/she…? Is he/she…? Do they…? Are they…?
Nghe 1 chi tiết rồi hỏi thêm.
Đường ý: job · personality · schedule · team
roleplay.useful: Does she work in sales? · Is she busy this week? · Do they work together?

roleplay.title: Mission 2 · Family photo
roleplay.context: Partner cho xem ảnh gia đình. Đừng đoán — hãy hỏi.
steps: Đường ý: relationship · work · place · free time
roleplay.useful: Does she live near you? · Does she work there? · Are they your parents?

roleplay.title: Mission 3 · Busy team
roleplay.context: Hai người đang nói về một tuần làm việc bận.
steps: Opener: Are they busy this week?
Hỏi về project, deadline, meetings, support.
roleplay.useful: Do they have many meetings? · Are they ready for the deadline? · Do they need your help?

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation about people you know. Use DOES/IS/DO/ARE questions and answer with full sentences.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ full answers. Notice when you use DOES vs IS.

reference.text: Che cột tiếng Anh, dịch từ tiếng Việt. Sau đó đảo chiều. Chạy lượt 2 theo thứ tự ngẫu nhiên.
